propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeIonConcentrationSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects ion concentration such as water hardness. HISTORY: Added in IFC4.

properties.name: SubstanceDetected
properties.definition: Identification of the substance that is being detected according to chemical formula.  For example, calcium carbonate is 'CaCO3'

properties.name: SetPointIonConcentration
properties.definition: The ion concentration value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.
